statements.status_notes: Vulnerability affects the security.json template shipped with Solr 9.4.0-9.10.1 (SOLR-18233). The DHI Solr image does not configure authentication by default; operators who enable Solr basic auth using the shipped template accept the risk documented in the advisory. Fix was backported to branch_9x on 2026-06-24 (apache/solr#4519) but 9.10.1 predates the backport (tagged 2026-01-20) and no 9.10.2 tag has been cut. Statement will be revisited when a 9.10.x point release containing the backport ships or when 9.11.0 is released.
